findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.116 Warewashing Equipment, Determining Chemical Sanitizer Concentration. Concentration of the SANITIZING solution shall be accurately determined by using a test kit or other device. 

1) The facility was unable to find their test strips for the sani buckets at the time of the inspection. 2) The facility does not have a testing method to verify the dish machine reaches critical temperature at the surfaces of the dishes (160F). Both situations were discussed with the PIC during the inspection and they were instructed to have both methods available prior to the follow up being scheduled.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

A can of sauce was observed with major dents in the side and in the seams. The PIC was shown and moved the can to discard to correct.  Ensure that all damaged cans are separated for credit/discard in the facility.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

Multiple wire shelves in the standing cooler next to the 3 part sink are observed with developing mold colonies on them. All foods in this cooler are sealed and not a concern for contamination at this time. PIC is instructed to clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Employee washed hands properly, then turned the faucet off without using a barrier/paper towel to prevent recontaminating clean hands. CORRECTED- Discussed handwashing with PIC and employees. Reference 2-301.12

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed quat sanitizer bucket at a concentration of 100ppm. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Fresh sanitizer bucket was made to a concentration of 400ppm.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114 (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. (P)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed shelving in the dry storage area that had the paint worn away and was now exposing bare wood. Ensure that if wood is used within the facility that it maintained either painted or sealed. This provides a smooth, easily cleanable surface. Repaint or seal the shelves in the dry storage. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak, with pooling water, under the three compartment sink. The pipes did not show active signs of leak, but there was water running from the rear of the bottom of the sink to underneath the sink. It appears that the leak is coming from the actual sink, but from an area that is not easilly viewable. Ensure that all plumbing is maintained in good repair.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed areas of the wall in the dry storage area, by the cambro storage, that have been damaged. These areas have no paint and dry wall has been exposed. Ensure that walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state. Repair the wall. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.
Observed a container of taco meat stored over buns and rolls.
Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.
CORRECTED = Container was moved below bread products.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed that there is a length coving missing at the wall / floor juncture behind the Hobart freezer unit.  
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
Replace the missing coving.
**Repeat Violation** = Note = This will be addressed during the summer break.
